```yaml
name: E2E Flow Tests

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      ai_provider:
        description: 'AI Provider for E2E tests'
        required: true
        default: 'openai'
        type: choice
        options:
          - openai
          - anthropic
          - google
          - openrouter

  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/**'
      - 'apps/web/package.json'
      - 'packages/cli/**'
      - '.github/workflows/e2e-flows.yml'

env:
  PNPM_VERSION: 8
  NODE_VERSION: 20

jobs:
  e2e-flows:
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || vars.E2E_FLOWS_ENABLED == 'true' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30

    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:15
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_DB: inbox_zero_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd pg_isready
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

      redis:
        image: redis:7
        ports:
          - 6379:6379
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "redis-cli ping"
          --health-interval 10s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 5

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup pnpm
        uses: pnpm/action-setup@v4
        with:
          version: ${{ env.PNPM_VERSION }}

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: ${{ env.NODE_VERSION }}
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build packages
        run: pnpm build

      - name: Setup ngrok
        uses: ngrok/ngrok-action@v1
        with:
          version: latest
          authtoken: ${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_AUTH_TOKEN }}
          command: http 3000
          options: |
            basic-auth=${{ secrets.E2E_NGROK_BASIC_AUTH }}

      - name: Set up environment variables
        run: |
          echo "DATABASE_URL=postgresql://postgres:postgres@localhost:5432/inbox_zero_test" >> .env
          echo "REDIS_URL=redis://localhost:6379" >> .env
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_EMAIL }}" >> .env
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_EMAIL }}" >> .env
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_CLIENT_ID=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_CLIENT_ID }}" >> .env
          echo "E2E_GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET=${{ secrets.E2E_GMAIL_CLIENT_SECRET }}" >> .env
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_ID }}" >> .env
          echo "E2E_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET=${{ secrets.E2E_OUTLOOK_CLIENT_SECRET }}" >> .env
          echo "AI_PROVIDER=${{ github.event.inputs.ai_provider || 'openai' }}" >> .env
          echo "OPENAI_API_KEY=${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}" >> .env
          echo "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY=${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}" >> .env
          echo "GOOGLE_API_KEY=${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}" >> .env
          echo "OPENROUTER_API_KEY=${{ secrets.OPENROUTER_API_KEY }}" >> .env
          echo "NGROK_URL=$(ngrok url)" >> .env

      - name: Run database migrations
        run: pnpm db:migrate

      - name: Run E2E Flow Tests
        run: pnpm test-e2e:flows
        env:
          CI: true
          GITHUB_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          GITHUB_REF: ${{ github.ref }}

      - name: Upload test results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: e2e-test-results
          path: |
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/results/
            apps/web/__tests__/e2e/flows/logs/
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Notify on failure
        if: failure()
        run: |
          echo "::error::E2E Flow tests failed. Check logs for details."
```
